headline: Since 10-24 the sheet's yesterday view showed the 07:00 ET bake at every moment because the CDN freezes trail files for days (one-line fix on this branch); NY high noon locks ran under the actual on 13 of 14 days.

findings.title: Yesterday view frozen at 07:00 ET by stale CDN trail
findings.evidence: cdn ny_high_2026-10-28.jsonl plain URL 85 rows to 07:00, age 82749 s despite max-age=120; bucket has 290 rows; 10-24..10-28 all truncated; index.html:19652 fetched the plain URL, now ?v=yd

findings.title: NY high locks too low 13 of 14 days
findings.evidence: kalshi_ny.json live err mean -1.18 over 14, run of 4 (10-25..10-28), two misses past 4 sd; hits 8/14 vs market 12/14; live court ll favours wider sd (1.5: 1.112, 1.0: 1.196)

findings.title: insider_study and trail_rows read the stale CDN copy
findings.evidence: insider_study.py:200 and kalshi_daily.py:3699 fetch without ?v=; insider_cache likely holds 07:00-truncated days from 10-24

findings.title: Review run itself froze today's trail at the edge
findings.evidence: ny_high_2026-10-29.jsonl cached at about 10:05Z by this run's step-2 fetch; 10-25/10-26 copies cached at 10:01Z/10:06Z; step 2 should fetch with ?v=<date>

findings.title: Kernel court flips on the 4th decimal
findings.evidence: kernel.json open 0.5479 vs bar 0.5479; use toggled 6 times since 10-14
